metadata.description:
The current Hennepin Avenue Bridge is the latest in a long lineage—it sits where the very first permanent bridge across the Mississippi was built in 1855. Today, its bright teal suspension cables and stately towers span the water with elegance and grit. It’s both a commuter route and a postcard view, connecting downtown with Northeast’s creative soul. You’ve earned this Bridge Builder POAP by standing where generations have passed before in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Bridge Builder 
GPS: 44.98526, -93.26383
